title: Al-Siḥḥah al-Nafsiyyah lil-Murāhiq: min al-Qalaq ilá al-Quwwah (13-15 sanah)
description: A medical/tarbiyah (nurturing) pathway that equips parents with tools to understand their child’s psychological health: depression, anxiety, ADHD, autism, mood disorders, and when and how to seek specialised help.

primary_reference.info: دليل AAP للصحة النفسية للمراهقين + DSM-5 المعايير التشخيصية

review_defects.arabic: الصحة النفسية للمراهق: من القلق للقوة (13-15 سنة)
review_defects.english: Al-Siḥḥah al-Nafsiyyah lil-Murāhiq: min al-Qalaq ilá al-Quwwah (13-15 sanah)
review_defects.why: The title is transliterated instead of translated, so the English reader gets no meaning from it. The Arabic title means 'Adolescent Mental Health: From Anxiety to Strength (13-15 years)'.

The Arabic adjective 'tarbawī' (educational/pedagogical) is replaced by the transliterated noun 'tarbiyah' with a gloss 'nurturing'. This misrepresents the term and introduces an unnecessary transliteration. Should be 'medical/educational pathway'.
The Arabic specifies 'ابنهم' (their son), but the English uses the gender-neutral 'their child', losing the masculine specificity.
